highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.2 adds missing tvOS surface creation APIs and improves native binary hardening.
highlights_body: Android symbols are now preserved in packages, helping diagnose native failures from deployed applications.

bullets.detail: Adds the missing SKSurface.Create overloads for tvOS applications.
Preserves Android symbols in packages to make native crash diagnosis more useful.

preview_summaries.v3.119.2-preview.1.2: Preview 1 added the tvOS surface creation overloads and Android symbol packaging.
preview_summaries.v3.119.2-preview.2.3: Preview 2 strengthened native binaries and continued package delivery improvements.
preview_summaries.v3.119.2-preview.3.1: Preview 3 finalized native binary hardening ahead of the stable release.

harfbuzz_summary: Includes the platform packaging and native hardening work that also touched the bundled HarfBuzz delivery.
